@redhat-chai-bot: This pull request is an upstream sync and explicitly references no jira issue.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/cloud-provider-ibm/pull/109):

>## Summary
>
>Rebase `openshift/cloud-provider-ibm` from upstream `IBM-Cloud/cloud-provider-ibm` branch `release-1.36`, pinned at commit `8b417bd7dbf9f7e19c184742f82ea0705d8ba24f` (June 29, 2026).
>
>This brings in Kubernetes 1.36.2 dependencies (`k8s.io/api v0.36.2`, `Version = "v1.36.2"`).
>
>## Why this PR
>
>The existing rebasebot PR #89 was overwritten by a subsequent bot run that pulled `release-1.37` (K8s 1.37.0-alpha.3) — which contains alpha APIs not appropriate for OCP 5.0 targeting K8s 1.36.
>
>This PR restores the correct K8s 1.36.2 rebase content from the clean sync that the rebasebot performed on June 29, before it was overwritten.
>
>## Root cause of the rebasebot issue
>
>The rebasebot's periodic job config uses `curl api.github.com/repos/.../branches` to dynamically select the latest upstream `release-X.Y` branch. This has two problems:
>
>1. **GitHub API pagination** — the `/branches` endpoint returns max 30 results per page (alphabetically). When 30+ branches exist (e.g. many `dependabot/*` branches), later `release-*` branches get pushed to page 2 which is never fetched. This caused the bot to incorrectly pick `release-1.32` at one point.
>
>2. **Latest != correct** — even when pagination isn't an issue, the bot picks the latest release branch (`release-1.37`), which may target a K8s version newer than what OCP needs.
>
>A separate PR to `openshift/release` is being prepared to fix the pagination issue by replacing `curl api.github.com` with `git ls-remote`.
>
>## Related
>
>- [OCPCLOUD-3593](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OCPCLOUD-3593) — Update cloud-provider-ibm to K8s 1.36
>- Rebasebot PR #89 — now contains K8s 1.37-alpha content (should be superseded by this PR)
>
>---

If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>
